ZND-1e kicker vertical slice, gated-EtBState branch (CR 702.27a + 614.1c).
Cragplate Baloth {5}{G}{G}, kicker {2}{G}: enters with four +1/+1 counters IF
it was kicked. Two identical-oracle copies, one world, two casts: the kick
choice rides the CAST journal row (paid vs not paid), the EtBState gate reads
it through WAS_KICKED, and the counters appear on the kicked permanent ONLY.
The mana lane prices both totals: 20G - (5G generic + 2GG + kicker 2G + G =
10G) - (5G generic + 2G = 7G) leaves exactly 3G, so the kicked cast paid the
FULL combined cost (an unpriced kick would leave 6G and falsify the pool).
Power/toughness 10/10 vs 6/6 is the counter effect seen through the layer
ledger, not just the counter table.
